assessment_source: Primary agent reviewed actual raw command/file events and independently checked artifacts; not third-party certification
recorded_issues: find_execute probed for AGENTS.md with no match (exit1); review/create probed an absent .agents/skills directory (exit2). These extra checks did not prevent delivery, but no optimal-step or latency claim is made.
review static helper exit1 is its defined findings/incomplete-coverage status, not a crash.

The first artifact checker incorrectly interpreted trial.md as the weekly output. The request called it a trial report; the checker was corrected to inspect its linked real weekly output. No task outputs were rewritten.

Generated reports used human-review wording for model source inspection. The public review copy corrects attribution explicitly; the bundled review reference gained one attribution sentence after host trials. That sentence was read back, not separately behaviorally retested.
limits: Single synthetic cases, not stable production or comparative accuracy evidence.
No additional search/review/creator skill was activated in observed tasks; the host itself still provides tools and model capability.
The fresh-reuse skill copy exists only in an isolated test workspace, not a real user installation of that generated skill.
Raw logs contain private machine paths and remain local; public summaries preserve receipt IDs and file hashes.
